signals.content: - Shashank Agarwal, Research Analyst (SEBI registered) - Education: Calcutta University (Accounts Finance), Delhi Institute of Management (Masters in Finance) - Experience: ISEC Securities (equity advisory), Mutilal Oswal, Angel One - Built Angel Ones customer onboarding platform and transaction execution system - Developed entire tech stack using Python - Current role: Wealth management (not stock picking) - Focus on mutual funds, bonds, CDs, PMS, AIF products - Avoids direct buysell calls due to client leverage risks

- Positive reception to advisory-to-execution platform idea - Addresses gap between WhatsAppTelegram recommendations and actual trading - Provides tracking and credibility vs unauthorized channels - Suggested categorization approach: - Different customer segments for each timeframe - Revenue model validation: Platform fees advisor subscription model viable

- Strong retail investor growth: 5 crore demat accounts in India post-COVID - Key challenges identified: - 90 of FO traders lose money - Platform credibility at risk if recommendations fail - Need for proper research basis vs speculation - Diversification opportunities beyond stocks: - Bonds, commodities, small case integration - Different products for different investor segments (retail vs HNI)

- Terminal integration approach recommended over website-only - Real-time signals with buyselltargetstop-loss - API integration with existing broker platforms - Pluginwidget model for seamless execution - Existing solutions reference: - Motilal Oswals trade guide signals (15,000year subscription) - Value Research, Morning Star for stock recommendations - Revenue streams: Subscription model (monthlyquarterlyyearly) transaction-based fees
